triggering_known-data_result.failure: No absolute-score threshold candidate reached the unchanged 70% attack-window gate.
triggering_known-data_result.diagnosis: Residual magnitudes remain release-specific after per-signal normalization, so applying one numeric score threshold across HAI 21.03 and HAI 23.05 is not domain invariant.

permitted_change: Calibrate each release's scalar anomaly score through its own normal empirical cumulative distribution, then apply one shared percentile threshold. No attack labels, attack windows or final-test values may enter either empirical normal distribution.
shared_threshold_policy: Search the original registered percentile grid and choose the first percentile whose HAI 21.03 normal calibration alert-event rate is at most two per hour. The identical percentile is applied to HAI 23.05 through its own normal empirical score distribution for selection metrics.
deployment_interpretation: A new physical installation must collect a registered normal calibration trace before this diagnostic is enabled. The model score is interpreted as normal-tail rarity for that installation, not as an absolute cross-device unit.
claim_boundary: Normal-CDF calibration is unsupervised domain adaptation. It does not demonstrate safety, authorize physical action or permit label-informed threshold tuning.
